meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理生物序列、解析文件、访问NCBI数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理FASTA/GenBank文件或需要批量查询NCBI。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate biological sequences, parse files, and access NCBI databases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with FASTA/GenBank files or need batch NCBI queries.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Python 处理 DNA、RNA 或蛋白质序列，读写 FASTA、GenBank 等文件，访问 NCBI 数据库，运行 BLAST 搜索，做序列比对、系统发育树和蛋白质结构分析。
howto.when: 当你要求处理生物序列、读写生物文件格式、访问 NCBI 数据库、运行 BLAST 搜索或进行系统发育分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 GenBank 下载序列 EU490707。
计算这个 FASTA 文件的 GC 含量。
用 BLAST 搜索这段 DNA 序列。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manipulate DNA, RNA, or protein sequences, read/write FASTA/GenBank files, access NCBI databases, run BLAST searches, perform sequence alignments, phylogenetics, and protein structure analysis using Biopython.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process biological sequences, read/write bio file formats, access NCBI databases, run BLAST searches, or perform phylogenetic analysis.

say_en.note: Claude will use Bio.Entrez to fetch and display the sequence.

say_en.text: Calculate GC content for this FASTA file.
say_en.note: Claude will compute GC percentage for each sequence using Bio.SeqUtils.
Claude will run NCBI BLAST and return top hits.
